However, I had a disappointing experience yesterday that I feel needs to be addressed.

I had an appointment to have my baby vaccinated at 4:40 pm. Unfortunately, I was delayed in traffic and called ahead to explain that I would be around 12 minutes late, with an ETA of 4:52 pm. The receptionist said she would inform the nurse, but then returned to the phone to say that if I was more than 10 minutes late, I would not be seen.

I arrived exactly 12 minutes late, as I had said, and was told I had missed my slot. I asked if I could wait until the end of the clinic, but was told there was no point as the nurse was fully booked. Despite this, I sat in the empty waiting room for 30 minutes breastfeeding my baby, during which time no other patients arrived.

It’s very frustrating that patients are often expected to wait beyond their allocated time without complaint, yet when the situation is reversed, there is no flexibility or compassion.
